result.paraphrase: Neural networks are used across many industrial and commercial applications. Binary neural networks (BNN) are especially useful when trading accuracy for performance, energy savings, or reduced hardware/software complexity. We present PIMBALL, a spintronic, reconfigurable in-memory BNN accelerator: Processing In Memory BNN Accelerator, designed for massively parallel, energy-efficient computation. PIMBALL can function at once as a conventional spintronic memory (STT-MRAM) array and as a computational substrate. We assess PIMBALL with several image classifiers and a genomics kernel, and simulations indicate it is more energy efficient than CPU-, GPU-, and FPGA-based alternatives while achieving higher throughput.
